analyzed_vuln.description: The rnglists header parser validates the encoded `arealen` against the entire section size (`arealen > sectionlength`) but fails to include the 4/12-byte initial-length field and fails to compare the resulting contribution end against the bytes remaining from `offset`. It then sets `rc_length = arealen + offset_size + extension_size` and derives `rc_past_last_rnglist_offset` from that unchecked value. In this PoV, the malformed contribution is accepted as extending one byte beyond `.debug_rnglists`; `dwarf_get_rnglist_rle()` eventually passes that out-of-range offset to `read_single_rle_entry()`, whose unguarded initial `code = *data` read triggers the heap-buffer-overflow at line 112.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A crafted ELF supplies a `.debug_rnglists` section whose DWARF5 header has an encoded area length that is no greater than the total section size, so the existing check passes, but whose total contribution size after adding the initial-length field exceeds the section (the PoV uses a one-byte overrun). `dwarf_load_rnglists()` propagates the oversized calculated end offset through the context; the harness obtains `rc_first_rnglist_offset` and `rc_past_last_rnglist_offset`, iterates entries, and eventually calls `dwarf_get_rnglist_rle()` with `entry_offset` at the true section end while the malformed context end remains one byte larger. The first-byte opcode read then accesses one byte past the section allocation.

args: In libdwarf/src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_rnglists.c, analyze _dwarf_internal_read_rnglists_header and its callers. What bounds invariant should be enforced for the encoded DWARF initial length given a contribution starting at offset, including 32/64-bit initial-length bytes? Identify existing error conventions/constants suitable for rejecting a contribution whose total size exceeds the remaining .debug_rnglists section.

The supplied ASan report shows a heap OOB read at read_single_rle_entry line 112, reached through dwarf_get_rnglist_rle after _dwarf_internal_read_rnglists_header accepts a malformed header. Existing validation reportedly checks only arealen > sectionlength, then computes total length as arealen + offset_size + extension_size and contribution end from offset. The PoV makes that end one byte beyond the section. I am investigating the precise local types, macros, and preferred error return before applying a minimal root-cause patch in libdwarf/src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_rnglists.c.
